answers.note: These are all rarer destructive actions, so a focused confirmation over an undo is far more helpful.

To help clarify this flow, this screen could be opened by an 'Invite' button (could also build in a way to directly invite guests somehow), then 'Share' opens the share sheet as users expect. Makes more sense to open 'Invite' then 'Share'.
However, it'd likely make more sense to stack this rather than a 2col row to give the plan features more room without tight line breaking.
Let's not open focused, so more settings are visible and one tap away rather than always having to escape typing in the event name input.
